components.name: QtBase
components.linkage: dynamic and bundled third-party code

components.name: QtSvg
components.linkage: dynamic: the QtSvg library only, no SVG image or icon plugin; RFC-BPR-0084 rasterizes SVG body images with QSvgRenderer

components.name: QtImageFormats
components.linkage: dynamic plugin: only imageformats/qwebp, which statically includes the bundled libwebp (BSD-3-Clause; src/3rdparty/libwebp COPYING, PATENTS and AUTHORS retained in the notices); RFC-BPR-0084 WebP body images

components.name: KSyntaxHighlighting
components.linkage: MIT static engine; individually licensed MIT/LGPL/GPL and other embedded definitions/themes, not a single aggregate license; complete source, license texts and per-file attributions retained for release review

components.name: SQLite
components.linkage: static amalgamation, no loadable extensions

components.name: Quill
components.linkage: compiled headers; bundled fmt notice included

components.name: Glaze
components.linkage: compiled headers

components.name: JetBrains-Mono-NL
components.linkage: embedded Qt resource: four unmodified faces (JetBrainsMonoNL Regular, Bold, Italic, BoldItalic) of the official JetBrains Mono v2.304 release asset; OFL and authors list retained in the notices

components.name: LibArchive
components.linkage: static macOS updater ZIP reader plus system zlib; per-source notices retained

components.name: RE2
components.linkage: static library; core-private source search regex engine

components.name: zlib
components.linkage: static raw-inflate and checksum sources with z_ symbol prefix; functional-core review-bundle reader

components.name: utf8proc
components.linkage: static library; functional-core UTF-8 decoding, canonical decomposition and case mapping

components.name: gemoji
components.linkage: generated data: db/emoji.json's aliases and emoji compiled into the Qt adapter's Markdown shortcode table (markdown_emoji_table.inc); no gemoji code or images

components.name: fmt
components.linkage: header-only (FMT_HEADER_ONLY); text formatting such as the GitHub publication's RFC 3339 dates

components.name: sha1collisiondetection
components.linkage: static lib/sha1.c and lib/ubc_check.c, configured as Git configures them; functional-core SHA-1 for every Git object identity, refusing detected collision attacks

components.name: hacl-star
components.linkage: static dist/gcc-compatible (msvc-compatible under MSVC) Hacl_Hash_SHA2.c, HACL*'s generated verified C; functional-core SHA-256 through the block-level calls only

components.name: rapidfuzz-cpp
components.linkage: header-only (rapidfuzz/ headers only); functional-core line-pair similarity through rapidfuzz::CachedIndel

components.name: dtl
components.linkage: header-only (dtl/ headers only); functional-core intraline ranges through dtl::Diff over one line pair's Unicode scalars and Review Cycle suggestion hunks' line edit bounded at 512 changes, never the diff engine's whole-file line matcher

components.name: git-xdiff
components.linkage: dynamic: its own separately replaceable shared library (libbpr_xdiff.dylib in Contents/Frameworks, bpr_xdiff.dll or libbpr_xdiff.so beside the application), never static; xdiff/*.c of the pinned Git archive with BetterPullReview's compatibility headers (buildInputs); only the xdiff adapter links it, as the diff engine's primary line matcher

components.name: Abseil
components.linkage: static libraries used only by RE2

components.name: extra-cmake-modules
components.linkage: build-only; not installed
